_about: Label taxonomy for the Data Explorer (specs/018 W22–W24). Two levels: residents' themes, each mapped to the DBM functional group, the COFOG division and (where it fits) one of the city's finish lines; sub-labels are Stride's proposal from the 2027 AIP and the budget books, status draft until Stride approves them in this file. Definitions are what the labelling model and the vectors read: write what a row IS, not which office runs it. Seed: pnpm --filter api db:seed:labels -- --dry-run

unclassified.label: Not classified
unclassified.definition: No evidence in the row's text or accounts for any label.

labels.label: Health
labels.definition: Keeping people healthy and treating them: hospitals, health centres, doctors and nurses, medicines, vaccination, disease control, nutrition, sanitation. A health office's own staff, supplies and running costs count here too.

subs.label: Hospital and clinical care
subs.definition: Hospital services, clinical and specialist care, diagnostics, laboratories, emergency care, mortuary.

subs.label: Primary care and health centres
subs.definition: Barangay health stations, health centres, primary and community health care, maternal and child health, dental.

subs.label: Disease prevention and control
subs.definition: Vaccination, communicable and non-communicable disease programs, mental health, surveillance, rabies, epidemics.

subs.label: Nutrition
subs.definition: Feeding programs, micronutrients, nutrition monitoring and education.

subs.label: Medicines and medical supplies
subs.definition: Drugs, medicines, pharmacy, medical and laboratory supplies and equipment.

labels.label: Education
labels.definition: Learning and schooling: support to public schools, scholarships, early childhood care and development, the city college, libraries, learners and teachers. An education office's own running costs count here too.

subs.label: Support to public schools
subs.definition: Classrooms, school supplies, teachers' support, school programs funded by the city or the Special Education Fund.

subs.label: Scholarships and student aid
subs.definition: Scholarships, educational assistance, student grants.

subs.label: Early childhood care
subs.definition: Day care, child development centres, early childhood care and development.

subs.label: Higher and technical education
subs.definition: The city college, tertiary and technical-vocational training.

labels.label: Infrastructure
labels.definition: Building, repairing and maintaining physical public works: roads, streets, bridges, drainage and flood control, public buildings, water and power systems, and the materials and equipment for those works. An engineering office's own staff salaries and office supplies are not infrastructure works.

subs.label: Roads and streets
subs.definition: Road construction, concreting, asphalting, widening, repair; streets, sidewalks, street lights, traffic signs.

subs.label: Bridges
subs.definition: Bridge construction, repair and retrofitting; footbridges.

subs.label: Drainage and flood control
subs.definition: Drainage canals, culverts, flood control structures, desilting of waterways, slope protection, river walls, pumping stations.

subs.label: Public buildings and facilities
subs.definition: Construction or repair of government buildings, markets, schools, health facilities, gyms, terminals, warehouses.

subs.label: Water and power
subs.definition: Water systems, water tanks, electrification, power lines, solar installations.

labels.label: Agriculture and fisheries
labels.definition: Farming, fisheries and livestock: farmers and fisherfolk, crops, irrigation, farm machinery, veterinary services, meat inspection, food production.

subs.label: Crops and farming
subs.definition: Rice, corn, vegetables, high-value crops, seeds, fertilizer, farm demonstration, technical support to farmers.

subs.label: Livestock and veterinary
subs.definition: Livestock, poultry, animal health, rabies control, animal population control, meat inspection, slaughterhouse.

subs.label: Fisheries
subs.definition: Fisherfolk, aquaculture, fishing gear, fish ports.

subs.label: Farm machinery and irrigation
subs.definition: Agri-mechanization, farm equipment, irrigation, post-harvest facilities.

labels.label: Social welfare
labels.definition: Help for people and families in need: crisis assistance, cash aid, relief goods, protection of women and children, residential care, programs for solo parents, indigents and vulnerable groups.

subs.label: Assistance to people in crisis
subs.definition: Financial, medical, burial and emergency assistance to individuals and families in crisis.

subs.label: Protection from abuse and trafficking
subs.definition: Anti-trafficking, violence against women and children, child protection, women's and children's desks.

subs.label: Residential and day care facilities
subs.definition: Homes and centres for women, children, the elderly; residential care.

subs.label: Pensions and cash benefits
subs.definition: Social pensions, birthday benefits, cash grants, allowances to beneficiaries.

labels.label: Housing
labels.definition: Homes and settlements: socialized and affordable housing, resettlement and relocation, land for housing, housing estates and homeowners' associations.

subs.label: Socialized and affordable housing
subs.definition: Housing projects, housing units, housing loans and estate management.

subs.label: Resettlement and relocation
subs.definition: Relocation of informal settlers, resettlement sites, social preparation.

subs.label: Land for housing
subs.definition: Land acquisition, inventory and titling for housing.

labels.label: Disaster risk and resilience
labels.definition: Preparing for, reducing and responding to disasters: early warning, evacuation centres, rescue, relief operations, the LDRRM Fund, risk mitigation.

subs.label: Preparedness and early warning
subs.definition: Drills, training, early warning systems, contingency plans, rescue equipment, evacuation centres.

subs.label: Response and relief
subs.definition: Emergency response, rescue operations, relief goods, quick response fund, rehabilitation after disasters.

subs.label: Risk mitigation
subs.definition: Structural and non-structural measures that reduce disaster risk: flood mitigation, slope protection, hazard mapping.

labels.label: Environment and waste
labels.definition: The environment and natural resources: solid waste collection and disposal, recycling, parks and greening, trees, watersheds, rivers, wildlife, pollution control.

subs.label: Solid waste
subs.definition: Garbage collection, sanitary landfill, materials recovery, recycling, waste trucks.

subs.label: Natural resources and watersheds
subs.definition: Watershed and protected areas, Mt. Isarog, forests, rivers, wildlife, tree planting.

subs.label: Parks and greening
subs.definition: Parks, plazas, urban greening, tree care, beautification.

labels.label: Peace, order and safety
labels.definition: Public safety: police and peace-keeping support, barangay tanods, traffic management, fire and emergency services, anti-illegal drugs, jail support.

subs.label: Police and public safety
subs.definition: Support to police, tanods, public safety officers, CCTV, peace and order council.

subs.label: Traffic and transport
subs.definition: Traffic management, enforcement, transport terminals and regulation.

subs.label: Fire and emergency services
subs.definition: Fire protection, emergency medical response, rescue units.

subs.label: Drug-abuse prevention
subs.definition: Anti-illegal drugs programs, rehabilitation, the drug-abuse council.

labels.label: Tourism, culture and the arts
labels.definition: Tourism, festivals and events, heritage, history, museums, culture and the arts, religious and civic celebrations.

subs.label: Tourism
subs.definition: Tourism promotion, destinations, tourist services.

subs.label: Festivals and celebrations
subs.definition: Peñafrancia and other festivals, city celebrations, civic events.

subs.label: Heritage, culture and the arts
subs.definition: Heritage sites, museums, history, arts and culture programs.

labels.label: Jobs, livelihood and business
labels.definition: Work and enterprise: employment services, livelihood programs, cooperatives, small business support, public markets, investment promotion and trade.

subs.label: Employment
subs.definition: Job placement, job fairs, public employment service, wage support, skills training for work.

subs.label: Livelihood and small business
subs.definition: Livelihood projects, cooperatives, MSME support, consumer protection.

subs.label: Public markets
subs.definition: Running and improving public markets, market vendors, slaughterhouse operations.

subs.label: Investment and trade
subs.definition: Investment promotion, industry development, trade fairs.

labels.label: Sports
labels.definition: Sports development, tournaments, athletes, sports facilities and physical fitness.

subs.label: Tournaments and events
subs.definition: Leagues, tournaments, championships, sports festivals.

subs.label: Athlete and sports development
subs.definition: Training of athletes and coaches, grassroots sports programs, sports equipment.

labels.label: Administration and governance
labels.definition: Running the city government itself: the Mayor's and Vice Mayor's offices, the city council, finance, budget, treasury and revenue collection, human resources, records, legal, planning, information technology, and general office support of offices with no service field of their own.

subs.label: Office administration and support
subs.definition: Personnel, supplies, utilities, administrative and human resource services, records, general support.

subs.label: Finance, budget and revenue
subs.definition: Budgeting, accounting, treasury, revenue collection, assessment, audit, debt service.

subs.label: Legislation
subs.definition: The city council (Sangguniang Panlungsod), ordinances, legislative support.

subs.label: Planning and monitoring
subs.definition: Development planning, zoning, monitoring and evaluation, statistics, CBMS.

subs.label: Digital government
subs.definition: Information technology, systems, connectivity, e-governance.

subs.label: Public information and participation
subs.definition: Information dissemination, public affairs, citizen participation, barangay affairs.

labels.label: Youth
labels.definition: Programs for young people: youth development, Sangguniang Kabataan, youth employment and leadership. A theme across fields: a youth scholarship is also Education.

labels.label: Children
labels.definition: Programs for children: child protection, children's rights, early childhood care. A theme across fields.

labels.label: Senior citizens
labels.definition: Programs for older people: social pensions, senior citizens' affairs, elderly care. A theme across fields.

labels.label: Women and gender
labels.definition: Gender and development (GAD), women's welfare and LGBTQIA+ programs. A theme across fields.

labels.label: Persons with disability
labels.definition: Programs for persons with disability: assistive devices, accessibility, PWD affairs. A theme across fields.
